Seedance 2.5 solves one of the biggest challenges in AI video generation: it creates a complete scene up to 30 seconds long without having to stitch separate clips together. The model handles changes in camera angles, locations, and pacing while keeping characters and the scene consistent throughout. Up to 50 references at once give you more control over characters, style, and the entire scene.

Key capabilities:

  • videos up to 30 seconds

  • up to 50 references

  • seamless long scenes
